title: Gỏi gà (Vietnamese chicken and cabbage salad)
steps: Poach the chicken in lightly salted water for 15 minutes, let it cool and shred it.
Finely shred the cabbage and carrot and slice the onion into thin rings.
Stir the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chopped chilli together.
Toss the chicken, vegetables and herbs with the dressing and sprinkle with chopped peanuts.
